items.text: Enjoyed meeting with @FOCUSBroadband, formerly Atlantic Telephone Membership Corporation, to discuss the importance of broadband deployment in rural areas to enhance healthcare, educational opportunities and economic growth. https://t.co/yT1QILWMJR

My bill, H.R. 5029, just passed the House through the STRONG Veterans Act of 2022!

This legislation will help ensure the families of servicemembers and veterans who have died by suicide can receive the critical mental health support they deserve.

Thank you to all the community leaders who joined me this morning for a roundtable discussion on our healthcare system.

Addressing rising costs and access to care is a continual challenge and I thank everyone for providing input to help shape legislative solutions. https://t.co/43Kpp7dlqZ

Thanks to everyone who recently joined me for a veterans roundtable in Wilmington.
 
Our conversation centered around increasing access to mental health resources for our veterans and their families & I’ll continue working to ensure they get the care and treatment they deserve. https://t.co/HdtXvz9kfQ

Great meeting with members of the @AmericanCancer Society from North Carolina to discuss legislation aimed at cancer research, prevention, and treatment.  Thank you for your advocacy on this important issue. https://t.co/QGxos888ov

Drug addiction impacts Americans from all walks of life and this week I joined my colleagues for #CongressGoesPurple in honor of National #RecoveryMonth.

No one should be alone in this fight. If you need help, visit https://t.co/16Ix1s9nEq for treatment options and resources. https://t.co/nCy0swot0v

Fentanyl-laced drugs are infiltrating communities throughout our country, yet Democrats in Washington continue to ignore this deadly crisis. When will they put Americans first? #SecureOurBorder https://t.co/SPXAhtKif4

Congrats to Samin Bhan & Atiksh Bhan for winning the 2022 @CongressionalAC for NC-07!

Their app, Lookupp, promotes mental health by encouraging users to look up, away from their screen, and have face-to-face interactions with the people they care about.

https://t.co/ObhwO3KJ2j

I’m humbled to receive the Drinking Water Leadership Award for my efforts to address PFAS contaminants and how they affect drinking water, health & the environment.

I will continue working to ensure families in Southeastern North Carolina have access to clean drinking water. https://t.co/pmbOxjG8fk

I enjoyed meeting with the Topsail Island Shoreline Protection Commission last week. We discussed beach renourishment on Topsail Island along with flood insurance and ways we can improve disaster recovery efforts. https://t.co/8YcTJIdAHi

I enjoyed meeting with NC-07's 2022 @CongressionalAC winners, Samin & Atiksh Bhan, to congratulate them on their hard work & success. 

Their app, Lookupp, promotes mental health and interpersonal relationships by encouraging users to look up from their phone screens. https://t.co/HXV4Ra7xL7

It was great to meet with @AARPNC members in my Wilmington district office to discuss their priorities and my commitment to lowering the cost of living and protecting Social Security and Medicare benefits our seniors have earned. https://t.co/lw6BOzBI5m

As we head into hurricane season, make sure you know what to expect from the hazards you may face during a storm. Remain vigilant, stay up to date with local news coverage, heed the advice of local officials, and stay safe. #HurricanePrep #HurricaneSeason2023 https://t.co/Ga8hO5Letg

With my support, this week the House passed The CHOICE Arrangement Act.

With rising healthcare costs, more small businesses are struggling to stay afloat. This bill provides more healthcare choices for employees while increasing affordability for small business owners.

With hurricane season in full swing, homeowners, renters and business owners should examine your flood insurance plans.

For more information on how you can prepare before disaster strikes, visit https://t.co/2LqQdsfwbC.

#FloodInsurance #BeReady

While it certainly costs more to rebuild homes damaged by storms because of rampant inflation resulting from President Biden’s failed economic policies, arbitrary astronomical increases in insurance rates are out of bounds.

I am sure Commissioner Causey will reject these high rate increases and work to reach the best outcome attainable under Bidenflation. Read more ➡️ https://t.co/2aMqDfxq9U

While in Wilmington, I had the opportunity to meet with the great team at Coastal Horizons. They’re changing lives as they help those struggling with mental health, addiction, and other crises. Thank you for the compassion and care you show our community. https://t.co/4VRLM2RwuG
Enjoyed meeting with Novant Health’s leadership to discuss ways to improve access to care and support the health and well-being of those across Southeastern North Carolina. https://t.co/26zQ08nU4R

This afternoon, I met with Prestage Farms and the National Turkey Federation to discuss the need for passage of a strong Farm Bill - investing in animal health and delivering economic certainty to farm country.  Prestage Farms is a family owned and operated turkey and pork processor based in Sampson County; they've  made incredible contributions to our state and country’s livestock industry, and I appreciate their input on these issues and all they’ve done for our area of North Carolina!

Great to see RFK Jr. confirmed as Secretary of HHS! For too long, our nation’s health has been put on the back burner. RFK Jr. understands a healthy America is key for a prosperous America. Looking forward to the positive changes ahead!
Thinking of President Biden and his family following the news of his cancer diagnosis. Wishing him strength and a full recovery.

Just wrapped up a productive meeting with Chancellor Philip Rogers of East Carolina University. Proud of the work ECU is doing to strengthen eastern North Carolina through education, healthcare, and innovation. Looking forward to our continued partnership! https://t.co/JAJdJwLkSJ

An inspiring group of men and women joined VA Secretary Collins, Congressman Hudson and I at the Fayetteville VA Medical Center to discuss how we can partner together to improve care for our nations veterans. There’s a lot of work ahead, but I’m eager to partner with an administration which shares my same commitment to our nation’s heroes.

https://t.co/qnI551W15H

This district work period I’ve gotten to tour some of the great small businesses in NC-07, like Koppers Inc. in Leland, a key player in wood treatment and infrastructure support. Proud to see innovation and good jobs right here in our community! https://t.co/AqYsyEAJwc

Met with Cape Fear Valley Health System and toured their medical center in Fayetteville last week! CFVH and Methodist University are working hard to bring the first medical school to Fayetteville in 2026! https://t.co/zHP3wPCchm
